title: 喜宴未散，清算開始

user_confirmed_rules.measurement_window: three calendar months from each main video becoming public

scoring.efficiency_zero_cost: undefined; do not divide by zero
scoring.overall_evaluation: present views and actual cost separately, then user compares both; no weighted automatic winner

window.start: actual public release time, not upload/private/unlisted time
window.end: same local clock time three calendar months later; clamp to last day if day absent

measurement.official_source: YouTube Studio Analytics and dated snapshots; reconcile platform reporting lag
production_cost_scope: accepted and rejected paid video generations
all four language TTS and retakes
music and SFX licences or generation
production storage and other paid production services
measurement.cost_cutoff: include all pre-release work and competition-period production repairs, even if invoiced later; reconcile accrued charges
measurement.shared_costs: allocate shared paid resources transparently under the same rule for both entrants; no hidden rejected assets
measurement.human_hours: record separately even when not invoiced; choose identical monetary treatment with opponent before final scoring
measurement.marketing: report separately; paid promotion not scheduled by this package

launch_checks: four approved audio tracks and four CC pairs ready
actual channel multilingual-audio entitlement and player tested
all tracks under the same video ID
synthetic content and audience fields reviewed by owner
no automatic public release from this package
diagnostics_not_win_conditions: impressions and CTR by comparable traffic source
average view duration and watch hours
audio-language results where Analytics exposes them
